next.reason: 1985: "each record-name of the associated record description entries must be the same"; 2023: "each name that is externalized to the operating environment for the record description entries shall be the same; the VALUE clause". 2023 matches externalized names, which AS literal-1 may set, not record-names. It adds an identical-VALUE rule and allows the complete REDEFINES only for records not strongly typed.
